games.name: The Ayuwoki Field
games.desc:
You are trapped at the Ayuwoki's field. There's no way to escape, just stay away from him and you'll be fine. How many nights will you survive?

This game is a mix between "El Bosque del Ayuwoki" by NahuelP25 and "THE RAKE: Classic Edition" by RVVZ.

Note for the english speakers that play this Roblox experience:
This game is originally in spanish, so when I add new text I have to translate it into english, and let's just say that sometimes I forget to translate it and.. yeaahh.. sorry if you find any text in spanish.

Music used:
Menu: Alice Mako - Dragon Riders
Intermission: Alice Mako - Stress Relief; Alice Mako - Flying Fortress II; Alice Mako - Some Patterns 14
Night: Kevin MacLeod - Gathering Darkness
Chase: Amnesia - Suitor Attacks

The game was remade on October 1, 2023.

games.name: [EARLY PAID ACCESS] Havoc
games.desc:
Use code SEASONTWO

Havoc immerses players in the aftermath of The Silence, a world where factions fight for survival and territory.

This is a hardcore extraction shooter built around real risk and consequence. It is loud, punishing, and unforgiving. Headphones are strongly recommended to hear threats early, as success depends entirely on your skill.

Havoc is currently available as paid access. Purchasing grants immediate access to the current build and all future updates.

>> The game runs on seasonal wipes. Gear, stash, and progress reset each season, but your profile and cosmetics are permanent.

Keybinds can be viewed in the Settings menu but cannot be changed at the moment.

>> The game is available on Console and PC. Controllers are not supported; mouse and keyboard are required.
